name: Programmable Transfer Function GUI Interaction
definition: A GUI implementation (using IMGUI) that allows users to dynamically modify variables in Programmable Transfer Functions, such as isovalue, shading color, volume step size, silhouette terms, silhouette coefficients, specular highlight augmentation coefficient, and intersection shading toggle, without recomputing and storing new transfer function textures.
summary: Programmable Transfer Function GUI Interaction is an interactive widget for dynamically editing volume rendering transfer functions via draggable control points without recomputing textures.
